Search PubMed and cache the results

Source: R/fetching.R
df_search_pubmed.Rd

Runs a PubMed query, fetches metadata for every hit and stores it in the project's metadata cache, ready for df_assess_batch(). Records that are already cached are not fetched again, which makes repeated searches cheap in a living review.

Usage

df_search_pubmed(
  query,
  metawoRld_path = ".",
  max_results = 10000,
  mindate = NULL,
  maxdate = NULL,
  email = Sys.getenv("DATAFINDR_EMAIL"),
  api_key = Sys.getenv("NCBI_API_KEY")
)

Arguments

query

PubMed query string.

metawoRld_path

Project root.

max_results

Maximum number of records. Defaults to 10000.

mindate, maxdate

Optional publication date limits ("YYYY/MM/DD", "YYYY/MM" or "YYYY").

email

Contact e-mail sent to NCBI and Crossref (recommended; NCBI may block anonymous heavy use). Defaults to the DATAFINDR_EMAIL environment variable.

api_key

NCBI API key (allows 10 instead of 3 requests per second). Defaults to the NCBI_API_KEY environment variable.

Value

A tibble with identifier (PMID), title, year and new (TRUE if the record was not in the cache before).
